neighbours.label: Best guess: ' in' after a word of likeness ('very similar in size'); ' in' after other adjectives, and plain sentences, stay low.
fire: Mars and Earth are quite similar in structure.
The twins are almost identical in height.
Both towns are comparable in size.
These two birds are alike in color.
The two cars are very close in price.
Oak and ash are roughly similar in weight.
The sisters are nearly equal in age.
Their houses are much the same in style.
quiet: Mars and Earth are quite far from each other.
The twins are almost bald in photos.
Both towns are on the river.
These two birds are noisy in spring.
The two cars are very old and rusty.
Oak and ash are growing by the road.
The sisters are nearly home from school.
Their houses are on the same street.

short: ' in' after a word of likeness (guess)
notes: The card has no consistent token (' and', ' in', ' the', ' able', ' well'). Probes: ' in' 0.30, ' the' after 'really happy' 0.23, ' and' 0.17; others under 0.13. Expected to fail.
